---
name: project-dazi
description: Dazi activity-coordination app — live URLs, backend, and non-obvious auth setup
metadata:
  type: project
---

Dazi is an activity-coordination app (post an activity, friends join with one tap, organizers can charge). Built end-to-end for JW on 2026-06-05.

- **Live:** https://dazi-chi.vercel.app (Vercel project `dazi`, account ngeowjiawen-3953)
- **Code:** github.com/epicsuperstar/dazi — Next.js 16.2.7 (App Router), at /Users/jaysonnorthstar/dazi
- **Backend:** Supabase project `dazi` (ref `gjehbkluxheicvqhprtk`), tables profiles/posts/joins with RLS

**Non-obvious, important:** The Supabase MCP has no auth-config tool, so the PRD requirement "no email confirmation blocking login" is enforced by a DB trigger `dazi_autoconfirm` (BEFORE INSERT on auth.users → sets email_confirmed_at).
